name: claims-api-newman-tests
description: Newman/Postman API test suite for the Claims Module (needs the API running on baseUrl).

scripts.test: npm run build:collection && newman run claims-api.postman_collection.json -e local.postman_environment.json --working-dir . --color on
scripts.test:ci: npm run build:collection && newman run claims-api.postman_collection.json -e local.postman_environment.json --working-dir . --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export results/newman.xml
